tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: The ground. Everything sits on it as a tile with a 4px gap (tile-gap). Fello's own ground color.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Tiles: the reading sheet, nav, metadata cells, cards, inputs.

tokens.name: sunken
tokens.usage: Table headers, code, hover on nav items and quiet buttons.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines inside a tile: between table rows, list rows, services rows. Decorative only.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs and secondary buttons, the step connector. 3:1 on paper, surface and sunken.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings on paper, surface, sunken and rail-soft. Also the primary button fill.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Metadata, captions, labels and small print on paper, surface, sunken and rail-soft.

tokens.name: ink-dim
tokens.usage: The grey second half of a two-tone headline. Text 24px and up only (3:1). Never for body text.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Dark rounded panels: Required callouts, the marketing services block, the footer.

tokens.name: on-panel
tokens.usage: Text and pill fills on panel.

tokens.name: on-panel-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on panel.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text on an ink fill (the primary button's label).

tokens.name: rail
tokens.usage: The only hue in the UI. The current step and nothing else as a fill. Never text.

tokens.name: rail-soft
tokens.usage: Highlighter: active nav item, search matches (mark). Text on it is ink or ink-muted.

tokens.name: on-rail
tokens.usage: Text on a rail fill, both themes.

tokens.name: rail-deep
tokens.usage: Accent as a mark: link underlines. 4.5:1 on paper and surface.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px focus ring, offset 2px.

tokens.name: approved
tokens.usage: Status: Approved. Text on approved-soft or surface. Blue on purpose, off the red-green axis.

tokens.name: approved-soft
tokens.usage: Approved badge ground.

tokens.name: review
tokens.usage: Status: In review. Text on review-soft or surface.

tokens.name: review-soft
tokens.usage: In review badge ground.

tokens.name: overdue
tokens.usage: Status: Review overdue; destructive actions. Text on overdue-soft or surface.

tokens.name: overdue-soft
tokens.usage: Review overdue badge ground.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Link text. Same as ink; marked by a rail-deep underline.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Marketing hero and big section openers. Ends with a period. 64px below 810px.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Page title of every policy and process. Ends with a period. 36px below 810px.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Section headings in a page; they feed the On this page list. 26px below 810px.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: How much time off you get, how to ask for it, and who says yes.
styles.usage: The summary under a page title. Can go two-tone: ink then ink-dim.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Ask your manager at least ten working days before your first day off.
styles.usage: Running text. Keep to the measure token. The one place tracking stays near zero, for reading.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Public holidays don't count against your balance.
styles.usage: Step bodies, callout text, card text.

styles.name: ui
styles.usage: Buttons, nav items, table cells, pills.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Section eyebrows (with the dot), helper text, footers.

styles.name: counter
styles.usage: Counts and order in parentheses: (04) items in a group, (01) a step. Only real numbers.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Versions, dates, policy IDs. Anything compared down a column.

tokens.name: tile-gap
tokens.usage: The gap between tiles on the ground. Fello's signature: tight gaps, big insides.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside a control group; between pills.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Pill and badge padding; icon to label.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Button padding; list gaps.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Phone page gutter (under 810px). Tile padding on phones.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Tile padding on tablet; gap between blocks in a tile.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Tablet page gutter (810 to 1199px). Tile padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Desktop page gutter (1200px and up).

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between a section eyebrow and its content; between sections inside a tile.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Between major blocks on a long page.

tokens.name: space-35
tokens.usage: Marketing section rhythm on desktop. 80px under 810px.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges on dense tables, step numbers, keyboard hints.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Tiles and cards: the reading sheet, nav, metadata cells, callouts.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Dark panels and full-width media.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, pills, search, status badges.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Menus and the search popover only. Tiles never get a shadow; the gap does the work.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Max width of running text.

tokens.name: page-max
tokens.usage: Max width of the shell. Fello's own container width.

tokens.name: nav-width
tokens.usage: Nav tile width from 1200px.

tokens.name: toc-width
tokens.usage: On this page tile width from 1440px.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, search. Pills read better a little tall.

tokens.name: nav-blur
tokens.usage: Backdrop blur behind the sticky top bar on phones and tablets.

tokens.name: bp-md
tokens.usage: Tablet. Gutter goes to space-7, type steps up.

tokens.name: bp-lg
tokens.usage: Desktop. Nav tile docks; gutter space-9.

tokens.name: bp-xl
tokens.usage: Wide. On this page tile appears.
